signal: AuthZed raised a $12M Series A from General Catalyst and launched the AuthZed Cloud API plus MCP servers, positioning authorization as the missing IAM layer at Identiverse 2026

email.body1:
Greg, saw AuthZed raised the $12M Series A and just put the Cloud API and MCP servers into preview, framing authorization as the missing IAM layer.

When the category narrative lands like that, more in-market accounts open up than the team can cover before new reps ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for AuthZed off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Greg, quick follow-up for AuthZed.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline climb faster than headcount can, and most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap surfaces late, then it is a scramble to save the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AuthZed needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Greg, last bit of proof for AuthZed.

Memgraph, also a technical infra startup, had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how AuthZed's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Greg, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a developer-infra Series-A motion? I will tailor it to AuthZed either way.
